title: FREE REQUEST Looking to create a team to help with Warriors of Elements

posts.author: Amberfira
posts.body:
I am making a game using RPG Maker MV called Warriors of Elements. It is a warrior cats RPG fangame. I had the idea for a while but never fully executed it due to not being good at some stuff. Mostly making tilesets, good maps, sprites, and coding for plugins, which I would love to learn how to do those stuff, as music can just include the default music and I probably get feedback on balancing my game.
Game info
(This uses fanmade clans from an old roleplay I had participated in and one I made specifically for the games universe)
In the game you are an outsider to four clans that were just founded, OwlClan, BlizzardClan, AshClan, and HollowClan. You have been found at the border of OwlClan the night before the first gathering of the clans and have been offered a place in OwlClan. Though the leader decides to wait for the gathering for your decision, in case you feel like a better fit in a different clan. Each clan will have a boost in different stats, stat reduction, a different element for most cats, and a different story. You can also pick to be a medicine cat apprentice but only two clans will allow that (AshClan and HollowClan) if you desire to play a support character
OwlClan: +HP & Agility, -Atk, Wind/Sky
BlizzardClan: +M.Atk & MP, -Def, Water/Ice
AshClan: +Atk & Luck, -M.Def, Fire/Lava
HollowClan: +HP & Def, -MP, Eath/Nature
My Roles
Eventing, concept artist, writer. Will attempt to do pixel art and coding.
Art example (Character that will be in-game)
Looking for
Artists:
I would like someone who can draw the title screen image and portrait expressions for the characters. That is mostly all they will need to do unless I can think of anything else as I am working on the concept art.
Spriter:
I would need someone to make the sprites. Would need them to also make parts of a character as if it would be in character generator as I plan on making it to where you can customize your character. Also to make various other stuff. Like the icons and such. Also would like them to make custom tilesets for me to use. Probably expanding from default tilesets instead of making entirely new ones.
Coder:
I would need someone to create plugins for various things for me. Just someone who can help me get the game to function how I would like it to.
Writer/Story Planner:
Just someone who can help me write the story and who I can just share ideas with and also get ideas from them of the events that should play out. Also maybe help with side character personalities.
Composer:
I will need someone to make custom music for my game.
Balance Designer:
I will need a person to help me with balancing my game and help with making skills, weapons, armors, items, and maybe custom statuses.
